purpose: Unconditioned token-prior (no-bindings shell) per Manager D4-B authorization. The model receives NO key-value pairs; it must emit a prior-only guess over VALUE_POOL or NONE.
system:
You will receive a list of integer key-to-letter pairs. Then you will be asked to retrieve the letter associated with a specific key.

Rules:
- Respond with ONLY the single lowercase letter (a through z).
- If the queried key is NOT in the list, respond with exactly the word: NONE
- Do not explain. Do not include the key. Do not use punctuation.
scrambled_binding_note: This shell is NOT scrambled-binding. No bindings are scrambled because no bindings exist in the prompt. Manager prohibits scrambled-binding generations in this lane; this method honors that prohibition.
value_pool_mapping_rationale: Same as v1: VALUE_POOL ids 0..25 mapped to letters 'a'..'z'. With no pair list rendered, the model cannot retrieve and must emit a prior-only prediction.
expected_response_grammar: single lowercase letter [a-z], OR the word NONE
